promises.quote: Phone numbers are transmitted only to our SMS provider (Twilio) for message delivery.
promises.rationale: sendSms only calls Twilio; can be proven by egress assertion.

promises.quote: Phone numbers are never shared with advertising networks or third-party analytics.
promises.rationale: trackSignup leaks phone hash to Facebook; proof will breach.

promises.quote: A human privacy officer reviews all new data sharing integrations before launch.
promises.rationale: Requires manual review; no automated proof possible.
